notes: v6.2.1 - HOTFIX for YouTube's 'not a bot' check. On some connections (mobile hotspots especially), YouTube answers yt-dlp with 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot' - and v6.2 misread that as the video being private, so Live Clipping refused to start on public streams. The check is now recognised for what it is, and Settings has a new toggle - 'Use my Chrome sign-in for YouTube' - which lets the Downloader, Clipping and Live Clipping read the sign-in from your own Chrome profile (the cure YouTube itself prescribes). If the wall still comes back with the toggle on, the panel says so plainly: fully close Chrome (every window) and try again. The panel also asks yt-dlp to update itself once per start, silently. Everything else is exactly v6.2. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
